paragraphs.source_en: After they crossed Iga Bridge, Iga Hachiman, revered for generations by the Matsudaira clan, appeared on their left. Jirōsaburō dismounted before the shrine and climbed the long flight of stone steps. Though only sixteen, he already knew perfectly well how to master the sorrow deep within his heart. He gazed straight at the sanctuary, without the slightest trace of grief or melancholy upon his face.

units.source_en: After they crossed Iga Bridge, Iga Hachiman, revered for generations by the Matsudaira clan, appeared on their left.
units.source_zh: 过了伊贺桥，松平氏祖祖辈辈尊奉的伊贺八幡出现在左手边。

units.source_en: Jirōsaburō dismounted before the shrine and climbed the long flight of stone steps.
units.source_zh: 次郎三郎在八幡神宫前下了马，迈上长长的石阶。

units.source_en: Though only sixteen, he already knew perfectly well how to master the sorrow deep within his heart.
units.source_zh: 虽只有十六岁，他已完全知道如何控制内心深处的悲伤。

units.source_en: He gazed straight at the sanctuary, without the slightest trace of grief or melancholy upon his face.
units.source_zh: 他直直地望着神殿，脸上看不到半点悲伤和哀愁。

paragraphs.source_zh: 过了伊贺桥，松平氏祖祖辈辈尊奉的伊贺八幡出现在左手边。次郎三郎在八幡神宫前下了马，迈上长长的石阶。虽只有十六岁，他已完全知道如何控制内心深处的悲伤。他直直地望着神殿，脸上看不到半点悲伤和哀愁。

paragraphs.source_en: When the worship was over, Jirōsaburō gave a slight nod to Uemura Shinrokurō, whose eyes brimmed with tears, withdrew from the shrine, and mounted his horse with unhurried ease. “My grandfather once galloped through these very lands.”

units.source_en: When the worship was over, Jirōsaburō gave a slight nod to Uemura Shinrokurō, whose eyes brimmed with tears, withdrew from the shrine, and mounted his horse with unhurried ease.
units.source_zh: 参拜结束，次郎三郎对着两眼蓄满泪水的植村新六郎轻轻点点头，退出神宫，悠然跨上马背。

units.source_en: “My grandfather once galloped through these very lands.”
units.source_zh: “祖父也曾在这一带纵马驰骋。”

paragraphs.source_zh: 参拜结束，次郎三郎对着两眼蓄满泪水的植村新六郎轻轻点点头，退出神宫，悠然跨上马背。“祖父也曾在这一带纵马驰骋。”

paragraphs.source_en: By the time the party reached Daijuji Temple in the village of Kamoda, the sun was already high in the sky.

units.source_en: By the time the party reached Daijuji Temple in the village of Kamoda, the sun was already high in the sky.
units.source_zh: 当一行人来到鸭田乡大树寺时，已是日上三竿。

paragraphs.source_zh: 当一行人来到鸭田乡大树寺时，已是日上三竿。

paragraphs.source_en: This Jōdo-sect temple, founded by Matsudaira Chikatada, the clan’s fourth-generation ancestor who bore the title Sakyō-no-jō, was an edifice that surpassed even the castle in this region. More than twenty years had passed since Jirōsaburō’s grandfather Kiyoyasu restored its seven principal halls in the fourth year of Tenbun, yet Daijuji showed no sign of decay; once its gates were shut, it was as impregnable as a fortress.

units.source_en: This Jōdo-sect temple, founded by Matsudaira Chikatada, the clan’s fourth-generation ancestor who bore the title Sakyō-no-jō, was an edifice that surpassed even the castle in this region.
units.source_zh: 松平氏第四代祖左京之进亲忠建造的这座净土宗佛寺，在这一带是凌驾于城池之上的建筑物。

units.source_en: More than twenty years had passed since Jirōsaburō’s grandfather Kiyoyasu restored its seven principal halls in the fourth year of Tenbun, yet Daijuji showed no sign of decay; once its gates were shut, it was as impregnable as a fortress.
units.source_zh: 自从次郎三郎的祖父清康于天文四年修复了七堂伽蓝后，已经过去了二十多个春秋，但大树寺仍然不见有荒废的迹象，关上寺门后，坚固得如同堡垒。

paragraphs.source_zh: 松平氏第四代祖左京之进亲忠建造的这座净土宗佛寺，在这一带是凌驾于城池之上的建筑物。自从次郎三郎的祖父清康于天文四年修复了七堂伽蓝后，已经过去了二十多个春秋，但大树寺仍然不见有荒废的迹象，关上寺门后，坚固得如同堡垒。

paragraphs.source_en: “Welcome, one and all!” The abbot, the venerable monk Tenkū, came out in person and greeted them warmly. Behind him stood some forty imposing monks. They were temple guardians who defended this sacred Buddhist ground amid an age of turmoil, not warrior monks.

units.source_en: “Welcome, one and all!”
units.source_zh: “恭迎诸位！”

units.source_en: The abbot, the venerable monk Tenkū, came out in person and greeted them warmly.
units.source_zh: 住持天空大和尚亲自迎了出来，殷勤地招呼着他们。

units.source_en: Behind him stood some forty imposing monks.
units.source_zh: 他身后站着大约四十个威武的僧侣。

units.source_en: They were temple guardians who defended this sacred Buddhist ground amid an age of turmoil, not warrior monks.
units.source_zh: 这些人是在纷争乱世里保卫佛家净地的护寺僧人，并不为僧兵。

paragraphs.source_zh: “恭迎诸位！”住持天空大和尚亲自迎了出来，殷勤地招呼着他们。他身后站着大约四十个威武的僧侣。这些人是在纷争乱世里保卫佛家净地的护寺僧人，并不为僧兵。

paragraphs.source_en: Jirōsaburō dismounted before the gate and strode swiftly toward the monk Tenkū. “I am grateful for your trouble, Reverend.”

units.source_en: Jirōsaburō dismounted before the gate and strode swiftly toward the monk Tenkū.
units.source_zh: 次郎三郎在门前下了马，疾步向天空和尚走去。

units.source_en: “I am grateful for your trouble, Reverend.”
units.source_zh: “有劳大师了。”

paragraphs.source_zh: 次郎三郎在门前下了马，疾步向天空和尚走去。“有劳大师了。”

paragraphs.source_en: “Not at all. This temple and the Matsudaira clan are bound by deep ties of faith, so there is no need for ceremony. Please, come to the guest hall!” He once again studied Jirōsaburō closely. Jirōsaburō looked remarkably mature for sixteen, but Tenkū found him cautious and circumspect—unlike his father Hirotada, and more like a brave warrior of profound judgment and seasoned composure.

units.source_en: “Not at all. This temple and the Matsudaira clan are bound by deep ties of faith, so there is no need for ceremony.
units.source_zh: “哪里，敝寺和松平氏佛缘深厚，您无须客气。

units.source_en: Please, come to the guest hall!”
units.source_zh: 请到客殿吧！”

units.source_en: He once again studied Jirōsaburō closely.
units.source_zh: 他再次仔细看了看次郎三郎。

units.source_en: Jirōsaburō looked remarkably mature for sixteen, but Tenkū found him cautious and circumspect—unlike his father Hirotada, and more like a brave warrior of profound judgment and seasoned composure.
units.source_zh: 十六岁的次郎三郎显得非常老成，但天空和尚觉得他小心谨慎，显得与其父广忠不同，更像个深沉练达的英勇武士。

paragraphs.source_zh: “哪里，敝寺和松平氏佛缘深厚，您无须客气。请到客殿吧！”他再次仔细看了看次郎三郎。十六岁的次郎三郎显得非常老成，但天空和尚觉得他小心谨慎，显得与其父广忠不同，更像个深沉练达的英勇武士。

paragraphs.source_en: The guest hall consisted of three rooms. The innermost room had once served as a retiring chamber for Chikatada and for Jirōsaburō’s grandfather Kiyoyasu; it would be his lodging during this stay in Okazaki and the place where he received his retainers. Compared with his residence in Sunpu, this felt far more like the dwelling of a daimyō.

units.source_en: The guest hall consisted of three rooms.
units.source_zh: 客殿共有三间。

units.source_en: The innermost room had once served as a retiring chamber for Chikatada and for Jirōsaburō’s grandfather Kiyoyasu; it would be his lodging during this stay in Okazaki and the place where he received his retainers.
units.source_zh: 最里面的房间是往日亲忠和次郎三郎祖父清康的休息室，就是此次停留冈崎期间的下处，也是接见家臣们的地方。

units.source_en: Compared with his residence in Sunpu, this felt far more like the dwelling of a daimyō.

ja.t: べると、ここははるかに

units.source_zh: 和骏府的住处相比，这里显得更像大名的居所。

paragraphs.source_zh: 客殿共有三间。最里面的房间是往日亲忠和次郎三郎祖父清康的休息室，就是此次停留冈崎期间的下处，也是接见家臣们的地方。和骏府的住处相比，这里显得更像大名的居所。

paragraphs.source_en: The senior retainers took their seats in the adjoining room. Once tea had been served, the monks began to study Jirōsaburō. His was no ordinary countenance. His distinctive ears and cheeks in particular would make him easy to recognize even in the midst of a crowd.

units.source_en: The senior retainers took their seats in the adjoining room.
units.source_zh: 老臣们在隔壁房里落了座。

units.source_en: Once tea had been served, the monks began to study Jirōsaburō.
units.source_zh: 上了茶水后，和尚们开始打量次郎三郎。

units.source_en: His was no ordinary countenance. His distinctive ears and cheeks in particular would make him easy to recognize even in the midst of a crowd.

ja.t: ではなかった。とりわけ

units.source_zh: 那不是普通人的面相，尤其是他那独特的耳朵和脸颊，即使混在人群中，也很容易据此将他识别出来。

paragraphs.source_zh: 老臣们在隔壁房里落了座。上了茶水后，和尚们开始打量次郎三郎。那不是普通人的面相，尤其是他那独特的耳朵和脸颊，即使混在人群中，也很容易据此将他识别出来。

paragraphs.source_en: The monks could not help exclaiming, “He resembles his grandfather so closely... There is profundity and fortitude in that majestic countenance, and his exceptional physique is filled with strength and courage.”

units.source_en: The monks could not help exclaiming, “He resembles his grandfather so closely... There is profundity and fortitude in that majestic countenance, and his exceptional physique is filled with strength and courage.”
units.source_zh: 众僧不禁叹道：“和他的祖父太像了……威严的容貌透着深邃与刚毅，不俗的体魄充满力量与勇气。”

paragraphs.source_zh: 众僧不禁叹道：“和他的祖父太像了……威严的容貌透着深邃与刚毅，不俗的体魄充满力量与勇气。”

paragraphs.source_en: “Will you visit the graves immediately after tea, or would you prefer to rest for a while first?” Tenkū asked.

units.source_en: “Will you visit the graves immediately after tea, or would you prefer to rest for a while first?”

ja.t: りになりますか。それとも、しばらくお

units.source_zh: “您是喝茶后即刻前去扫墓，还是稍事休息后再去？”

units.source_en: Tenkū asked.
units.source_zh: 天空问道。

paragraphs.source_zh: “您是喝茶后即刻前去扫墓，还是稍事休息后再去？”天空问道。

paragraphs.source_en: “I shall follow everyone’s wishes.” Jirōsaburō replied.

units.source_en: “I shall follow everyone’s wishes.”
units.source_zh: “看众人的意思。”

units.source_en: Jirōsaburō replied.
units.source_zh: 次郎三郎答道。

paragraphs.source_zh: “看众人的意思。”次郎三郎答道。

paragraphs.source_en: The monk could not help looking Jirōsaburō over once more. Jirōsaburō felt as though some immense weight were pressing down upon him. Leaving aside the Okazaki Castle he had just seen, what had his forebears themselves hoped for? And by what power had they built these seven great halls...? His chest felt oppressed, and he was somewhat lost.

units.source_en: The monk could not help looking Jirōsaburō over once more.
units.source_zh: 和尚不由再次打量了一下次郎三郎。

units.source_en: Jirōsaburō felt as though some immense weight were pressing down upon him.
units.source_zh: 次郎三郎觉得自己被某种沉甸甸的东西压着。

units.source_en: Leaving aside the Okazaki Castle he had just seen, what had his forebears themselves hoped for?
units.source_zh: 且不论刚才看到的冈崎城，就说自己的先辈，他们究竟在期盼什么？

units.source_en: And by what power had they built these seven great halls...? His chest felt oppressed, and he was somewhat lost.
units.source_zh: 又是依靠什么力量建造起这七堂伽蓝……他胸中烦闷，有些迷茫。

paragraphs.source_zh: 和尚不由再次打量了一下次郎三郎。次郎三郎觉得自己被某种沉甸甸的东西压着。且不论刚才看到的冈崎城，就说自己的先辈，他们究竟在期盼什么？又是依靠什么力量建造起这七堂伽蓝……他胸中烦闷，有些迷茫。

paragraphs.source_en: At that moment, the senior retainers began entering one after another. “The preparations for visiting the graves are complete.”

units.source_en: At that moment, the senior retainers began entering one after another.
units.source_zh: 这时候，老臣们陆陆续续进来了。

units.source_en: “The preparations for visiting the graves are complete.”
units.source_zh: “参拜墓地的准备已做好了。”

paragraphs.source_zh: 这时候，老臣们陆陆续续进来了。“参拜墓地的准备已做好了。”

paragraphs.source_en: He felt the solemn weight of a warrior house and truly understood that he was the heir and bearer of the Matsudaira bloodline...

units.source_en: He felt the solemn weight of a warrior house and truly understood that he was the heir and bearer of the Matsudaira bloodline...
units.source_zh: 他感受到了武将家族的凝重，真正明白了自己是松平血脉的延续者和传承者……

paragraphs.source_zh: 他感受到了武将家族的凝重，真正明白了自己是松平血脉的延续者和传承者……

paragraphs.source_en: Leading his chief retainers, Jirōsaburō followed the monk Tenkū to the ancestral burial ground. Five enormous pine trees towered over the cemetery, with several birds’ nests among their upper branches.

units.source_en: Leading his chief retainers, Jirōsaburō followed the monk Tenkū to the ancestral burial ground.
units.source_zh: 次郎三郎率领着重臣们，在天空和尚的引领下到了祖先的墓地。

units.source_en: Five enormous pine trees towered over the cemetery, with several birds’ nests among their upper branches.
units.source_zh: 墓地矗立着五棵巨大的松树，树梢上有几个鸟窝。

paragraphs.source_zh: 次郎三郎率领着重臣们，在天空和尚的引领下到了祖先的墓地。墓地矗立着五棵巨大的松树，树梢上有几个鸟窝。

paragraphs.source_en: When the rites were concluded, Tenkū led him back to the temple gate and showed him the plaque bestowed by Emperor Go-Nara and hung in the upper story, bearing the three characters “Daijuji”: “This plaque was graciously bestowed in the eleventh month of the second year of Tenbun, during Lord Kiyoyasu’s time.”

units.source_en: When the rites were concluded, Tenkū led him back to the temple gate and showed him the plaque bestowed by Emperor Go-Nara and hung in the upper story, bearing the three characters “Daijuji”: “This plaque was graciously bestowed in the eleventh month of the second year of Tenbun, during Lord Kiyoyasu’s time.”
units.source_zh: 祭祀完毕后，天空和尚又领他回到山门，向他介绍悬挂在楼上的后奈良天皇所赐匾额，上面题着“大树寺”三字：“此为清康公时，天文二年十一月御赐的匾额。”

paragraphs.source_zh: 祭祀完毕后，天空和尚又领他回到山门，向他介绍悬挂在楼上的后奈良天皇所赐匾额，上面题着“大树寺”三字：“此为清康公时，天文二年十一月御赐的匾额。”

paragraphs.source_en: The abbot next showed Jirōsaburō the tahōtō pagoda and Kiyoyasu’s calligraphy carved into a stone pillar, then brought him to admire the image of Amida Crossing the Mountains that Chikatada had donated to Daijuji.

units.source_en: The abbot next showed Jirōsaburō the tahōtō pagoda and Kiyoyasu’s calligraphy carved into a stone pillar, then brought him to admire the image of Amida Crossing the Mountains that Chikatada had donated to Daijuji.
units.source_zh: 接下来住持领着次郎三郎观看了多宝塔，观摩了清康镌刻在石柱上的手迹，还带他欣赏了亲忠捐给大树寺的山越弥陀佛画像。

paragraphs.source_zh: 接下来住持领着次郎三郎观看了多宝塔，观摩了清康镌刻在石柱上的手迹，还带他欣赏了亲忠捐给大树寺的山越弥陀佛画像。

paragraphs.source_en: Jirōsaburō merely nodded in silence. Until then, he had felt only that his retainers were united around him; now he felt that he had joined the company of his many ancestors.

units.source_en: Jirōsaburō merely nodded in silence.
units.source_zh: 次郎三郎只是默默地点头。

units.source_en: Until then, he had felt only that his retainers were united around him;
units.source_zh: 之前，他只感到家臣们团结在周围；

units.source_en: now he felt that he had joined the company of his many ancestors.
units.source_zh: 而今，他觉得自己和众多的祖先走到了一起。

paragraphs.source_zh: 次郎三郎只是默默地点头。之前，他只感到家臣们团结在周围；而今，他觉得自己和众多的祖先走到了一起。

paragraphs.source_en: At last, everyone returned to the guest hall.

units.source_en: At last, everyone returned to the guest hall.
units.source_zh: 众人终于回到客殿。

paragraphs.source_zh: 众人终于回到客殿。
